en: The postcard is a black-and-white photograph showing a historical European street view. A tall church or cathedral tower with a clock and a baroque-style dome dominates the background. The street is lined with old buildings and trees, with a few people visible, including someone standing and others sitting on the right. In the foreground, there is printed red text at the bottom identifying the location as Dippoldiswalde.
